newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 68 bln marks in repos at 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 68 bln marks in repos at 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated 68.0 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent.

The central bank accepted 41.75 percent of the bids for the 14-day funds. A repo pact for 71.1 billion marks at a fixed 3.00 percent expires today, Wednesday, so a net 3.1 billion marks is flowing out of the money market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 162.9 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. The repo rate has been fixed at 3.00 percent since late August.
